name: notes
description: Keeps running notes on many topics organized in plain Markdown: captures as you go, regroups each topic into In progress, TODO, Done and Notes without losing a line, shows what is open, and turns TODO, in-progress and inline "text"(todo|wip|done) markers into GitHub tickets assigned to you on your default board. Use when asked to note something, organize notes, list open TODOs, or file notes as tickets.
